KIBORI木彫
Transition between scenes
Vanilla JavaScript · DOM/CSS · scroll-derived state

Horizontal
Scroll Scenes

Five crafts laid left to right on one stage. Vertical scroll is the only input: each screen of it is a place you can land, reverse through, skip across or reload into.

No WebGL, no GSAP, no wheel hijack, no scroll-snap. The page height is the timeline; one pure function turns scrollY into scene, dwell and move.
